d: Tiny clues tell a lot about the murder of a young woman found in a ravine.
Forensics determines whether a woman's death in a fire is due to arson, murder or accident.
Ammunition box and fibers reveal the betrayal that led to the murder of a millionaire's family.
The kidnapping of Adolph Coors leads to one of the most intense manhunts in US history.
The development of technology could help solve a murder case that is twelve years old.
Cutting-edge technology proves the police arrested the wrong suspect in a young girl's murder case.
A man is found strangled and burned, and the killer thinks he has destroyed all the evidence.
Two men die of heart disease six years apart and each was once married to the same woman.
Casino security cameras offer the final images of a woman, just before she vanishes without a trace.
A squashed tomato and a pinpoint reflection of light in a photo help catch a killer.
An ATM transaction allows Texas detectives to pinpoint a suspect in the slaying of a teacher.
Ten years after the murder of a rock singer, scientists use evidence to bring her killer to justice.
A professor of geological sciences helps police get the dirt on a woman's killer.
A man's wife kills herself 14 years after his college sweetheart commits suicide.
A woman, who had recently rejected a co-worker half her age, ends up dead in her driveway.
A pair of tennis shoes are found near a victim who had been stabbed on the beach.
Three fingerprints on a window screen are enough for a print examiner to uncover a serial killer.
With a long list of suspects, forensic experts agree that the killer in this crime knew his victim.
The only lead to a serial killer is a bloody fingerprint on the body of a victim.
Tests reveal the race, eye color and hair color of the person who killed two young women.
Two women went missing and were later found brutally murdered.
The killer hoped to cover their tracks by staging the crime scene, but failed.
A six-year-old girl ran and hid when she saw her grandmother being beaten to death.
In 1984, the body of college co-ed Laura Salmon was found on a Middle Tennessee farm.
The body of an attractive young woman was found a mile from her abandoned car.
In 1969, 25-year-old phone operator Diane Maxwell was raped and murdered.
The crime scene was especially violent: A husband and wife had been shot to death in their bedroom.
A young, attractive hairdresser was sexually assaulted and murdered in her own beauty salon.
A human skeleton was discovered in the North Carolina marshlands.
After shooting the victims in the head, the killer staged the scene.
In a tragic twist of fate, just days after the woman sold her home and moved to a modest trailer, a fire took both the trailer and her life. But the autopsy proved this was no accident.
A security guard disappeared from his post without a trace.
After the suspect was convicted of arson and murder, he was sentenced to 25 years in prison.
A college senior was found raped and murdered near an unpaved footpath.
A woman was brutally murdered in her home, and the only witnesses to the crime were the family dogs.
Police are puzzled about a murder until a frozen river five miles away provides a breakthrough.
Eyewitness to murder is put under forensic hypnosis in order to help him recall the killer's face.
A teenager returns home to find his father's body in a pool of blood.
Pathologist examining death of politician running for re-election finds puncture wounds at autopsy.
Naval officer threatening to go public about sexual harassment and assault at work is murdered.
A man is found stabbed to death after a night in a strip club; a drop of blood becomes evidence.
Details don't add up when police suspect a young woman committed suicide.
Police believe the victim knew the killer when the huge amount of blood found suggests overkill.
Police uncover a bizarre sequence of events that may prove a man innocent of killing his wife.
Evidence supports a woman's far-fetched story of her rape and boyfriend's murder.
After a Delaware man's mother is found dead, he tells police an improbable story.
After a carjacking, police have a small window of opportunity to locate a mother and her child.
New clues are found in the form of a phone and shoes in a rape and murder case unsolved for 8 years.

When a college student is reported missing, police believe their investigation will be like countless others. But when they discover blood spatter in her boyfriend's bedroom, they know this case is going to be different.

A young woman is found dead in her apartment. With little evidence at the scene, the case turns cold until police discover a link between their prime suspect and an unsolved murder committed six years earlier in a different state.
Texas police hunt frantically for a brutal rapist as his crimes grow increasingly violent in nature.
Detectives find a mismatched button and follow the thread back to a woman's killer.
A young woman disappears after attending evening church services.
Psychic leads volunteers and police to a field where the body of a missing girl is found.
Digital enhancement of CCTV footage captures a kidnapping that leads to murder.
When DNA proves that a man is innocent of a brutal attack, police wonder why he takes the blame.
When a businessman is murdered, the motive may be a disgruntled employee, client, or racy photos.
A family vacation turns into a nightmare when the wife is found face down in the lake.
Friends see a woman in the back of a car flailing her arms, not realizing she is being abducted.
A distant DNA sample may lead to killer of a husband and critically injured wife.
Detectives believe a murder is solved when they find the weapon and victim's blood in a man's flat.
This episode documents a deadly bombing at a church in Oakwood, Illinois, in December 1997.
This episode documents a deadly bombing at a church in Oakwood, Illinois, in December 1997.
Pathologists find a tiny pinprick on a student's arm offering the only clue to her cause of death.
The victim had been stabbed more than a hundred times, leaving her bedroom soaked with blood.
Police create a composite sketch of a man burnt beyond recognition.
Forensics study a strand of a murdered man's hair to reveal a record of his last six months alive.
A bullet-riddled car, a missing driver, and no witnesses. Was this an ambush or a random attack?
Teenager is found half-naked with her throat slit. A single hair on her thumb may finger the killer.
Serial killer who hates women, brutally murdered two women who lived in the same apartment complex.
Body of an unknown female is discovered 700 miles away from where a college student went missing.
Moments before she dies, a woman writes a name on a wall with her blood.
Restaurant's assistant manager is killed and $8,000 is missing from the safe.
A convenience store safe was empty and the clerk's naked body was found at nearby woods.
Killer's store discount card is captured on CCTV as he attempts to dispose of a body by burning it.
Respected surgeon is stabbed to death. However, the key suspect has a solid alibi.
The gunman opened fire as the family of four entered their home, killing two and wounding the others. He'd pulled open a few drawers to make it look like a robbery, but the scene was clearly staged.
In 2007, Brian and Beverly Mauck were found dead in their Graham, Washington home.
On May 12, 1994, Crystal Perry was viciously murdered in her home in Bridgton, Maine.
Woman's body is found but her ex-husband disappears with their daughter.
Six years later, advances in DNA helped crack the death of a park employee.
When evidence shows a woman's rape and murder, police must find the killer as well as the victim.
A week after a couple disappears from the beach, police get a mysterious lead from a robbery.
The decade-old murder of a young Texas housewife is investigated.
Key suspects in woman's murder maintain their innocence. But the victim would help prove that false.
Soft tissue on a cremated foot may still contain enough DNA to help police solve a woman's murder.
The investigation into a missing flight attendant leads to her pilot husband's conviction.
A woman disappeared, and her husband became the prime suspect.
Sitting in the apparently safe lobby of his father's gun club, a teenage boy is mysteriously shot dead.
Scientists and detectives use DNA to solve a string of rapes and murders.
Early one morning in a deserted area outside of Phoenix, a motorcyclist discovered the body of a young woman. She had been beaten, bound, strangled, and possibly raped.
FBI psychological profiling and DNA fingerprinting track a serial rapist and murderer.
When 182 war veterans contract pneumonia-like symptoms in Philadelphia, doctors become stumped.
After a wealthy Southern physician's murder, his wife and a handyman become convicted of the crime.
Investigators solve the 1988 murder of a drifter by examining a species of fly found near the body.
Scientists investigate high levels of thyroid hormones in South Dakota residents.
A murderer eludes the law for years until an age-scaled sculpture helps lead to his arrest.
After a weekend retreat, a Boy Scout's organs start shutting down, leaving doctors puzzled.
Florida police search for a serial killer who left small red fibers on each of his 10 victims.
A man becomes the prime suspect in the deaths of his parents as police examine mud and blood traces.
The sudden appearance of thick fog causes a 99-car accident on I-75 in Tennessee, killing 12.
Footage from a TV crew helps local detectives solve a mystery surrounding a missing woman.
When a woman exhibits flu-like symptoms before dying, investigators determine she was poisoned.
Police uncover a trail that reveals a husband's plot to kill his wife for insurance money.
Dozens of infants develop serious breathing problems in the Cleveland area.
A custodian finds a burned body in a dumpster and investigators try to determine its identity.
Researchers investigate a woman's sudden death after taking aspirin.
A teacher who complained of being stalked and harassed by another teacher was scamming police.
A man kills two people with bombs in an effort to get investors off his back.
Microorganisms found in the mouth of a murder victim lead to the killer.
Heavy rains and snow runoff carry manure into Milwaukee's water supply, making 400,000 people ill.
Autopsies connect several deaths to poison-induced liver disintegration.
Microscopic evidence helps solve murders near Sacramento, Calif.
After the discovery of a skull in the forest, police use facial reconstruction to identify the body.
Investigators search for the person responsible for killing justice officials with mail bombs.
Detectives find a girl's disappearance has suspicious similarities to her sister's disappearance.
Forensic scientists re-examine a death previously ruled accidental.
Detectives learn a genetic disorder caused children's deaths, overturning their mother's conviction.
A strand of hair and traces of blood lead investigators to a woman's killer.
The use of DNA testing helps exonerate a person accused of raping a young Virginia woman.
A speck of bicycle paint and a speck of nickel tie a suspect to the murder of a 9-year-old.
A mother with Munchausen syndrome by proxy kills one child and physically abuses another.
A drop of blood and burned bones provide evidence of murder two years after the investigation began.
A drop of blood and burned bones provide evidence of murder two years after the investigation began.
The apparently motiveless murders of two children baffle police.
When the police sprayed Scott Dunn's bedroom with luminol, a scene of horrific violence emerged.
A 1995 fire razes the mansion of a Kansas doctor, killing two of her three children.
Forensics contradicts a husband's confession to his wife's murder.
Virginia police use hair from a rabbit-fur jacket to determine a 5-year-old girl's abductor.
Doctors discover a man's illness is from poison being inflicted by his wife.
An obscure style of rope and forensic analysis lead to the arrest and conviction of a murderer.
Mark Fair left for work, and his fiancée, Karla Brown, stayed home. Later, he found her dead.
Police reopen a case involving a woman who appeared to die from an accidental fall.
In 1996, more than a dozen children in Seattle, Washington, were fighting for their lives.
A woman is haunted by the memory of her father murdering her mother.
Young Navajos in the Southwest were dying at an alarming rate.
Investigators come to suspect a wife's bathtub drowning may not have been an accident.
A cigarette butt may provide the evidence needed to catch a serial rapist.
New evidence points to a different killer in the case of a dentist's murdered wife.
Insects and a strand of hair unravel the truth behind the murder of a woman and her infant son.
A decomposed body is found in a barrel, and a dilapidated address book may hold the answer.
When a policeman's home burns to the ground, he arrests a man who confesses to arson.
A woman identifies her husband as her attacker, but questions arise 16 years later.
A mother and her two young daughters are found brutally murdered and sexually violated.
11-year-old Krista Harrison is raped and murdered. There are a few clues to the killer's identity.
Medical detectives believe a murder suspect may not have killed his wife after all.
Children die at an alarming rate at a Texas hospital, and one nurse may be involved.
When the decomposed body of a young girl is discovered, police have no clues to her identity.
Investigators use the recollections of a child to determine what happened to a missing woman.
A postcard incriminates a high religious figure with crimes committed during World War II.
Investigators look into the death of a teacher and discover that his death was not an accident.
The only obvious clues to a dead man's identity are a Rolex watch and a tattoo.
6-year-old Nicole Rae Walker was killed in a hit-and-run in her Ft Lauderdale neighborhood.
A prosecutor helps make video testimony viable in the case of a child's death due to drunk driving.
When 23-year-old Tina Biggar goes missing, her boyfriend and family fear she has been murdered.
When a young woman disappears, investigators discover that she led a double life.
A tiny clue inside a suspect's watchband and a popular television show help solve a case.
In 1991, Maine resident Pearl Smith was missing after an argument with her husband, Bill Bruns.
When a young girl is found dead, her parents tell the police that dogs attacked and killed her.
An anonymous letter, containing details only the killer would know, offers clues to a murder.
A teen's role in a high school production of "Hamlet" exposes the truth behind her father's death.
A mother attempts to clear her name after authorities charge her with murdering her son in a fire.
A forensic scientist uses his skills to preserve a footprint left in snow.
In 1992, 22-year-old Dawn Bruce was brutally murdered in her Virginia apartment.
A suspect is profiled in the disappearance of a 6-year-old girl during a church service.
Photographs found in a dumpster lead to the killer of a model.
An evening out at a Maryland murder mystery theater performance turns into a real-life whodunit.
When a woman dies in a horseback riding accident, police uncover a web of lies.
A serial killer taunts police by strangling prostitutes and leaving their bodies in plain sight.
A police investigation uncovers a web of homeless drifters, cattle auctions and bad checks.
A human skull retrieved from a watery grave reveals a ghastly crime.
A doctor is accused of sedating and sexually assaulting two female patients.
A common trait among serial killers is a history of abusing animals.
The tests of a plant pathologist and a dendrochronologist lead to a surprising revelation.
A son searches for the truth when his mother is charged with the murder of his father.
The pornography empire cultivated by Artie and Jim Mitchell crumbles after one brother is murdered.
The body of a female prison guard is discovered at a landfill.
The investigation of a murder case in New Jersey is stalled until a similar attack occurs.
Technology, cat hairs and insects point investigators to a woman's abductor.
Blood spatter analysis and an investigation lead police to the truth when a woman is found dead.
A mother is determined to discover what happened when her daughter is injured.
A mother and daughter disappear after heading out for a shopping spree.
